meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only for external windows or desktop UI that needs OS-level control, and Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从命令行调度开发工作区,完成智能体间的任务交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你同时跑多个开发智能体,需要在工作区、终端和任务间来回切换。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate dev worktrees and hand off tasks between agents from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple dev agents and need to switch between their worktrees, terminals, and ongoing tasks.

howto.what: 它会先确定本次会话该用哪个 orca 可执行文件，加载与版本匹配的指南，再通过命令行操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、仓库、产物、技能分享和内嵌浏览器。
howto.when: 当你提到 “$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”、“handoff” 等关键词，或需要操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、浏览器时由它接管。

say.text: 用 orca 新建一个子工作树
say.note: 先解析可执行文件，再建工作树

say.text: 帮我读一下 Orca 终端里的输出
say.note: 读取、等待或发送 Orca 终端内容

say.text: 把这个任务 handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 转交当前 Orca 会话

howto.what_en: It first resolves which orca executable this session should use, loads the version-matched guide, then operates Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts, skill sharing and the embedded browser via the CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" and similar keywords, or need to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, or the Orca browser.

say_en.text: Create a new child worktree with orca
say_en.note: Resolves the executable, then makes the worktree

say_en.text: Read the output in my Orca terminal
say_en.note: Reads, waits, or sends Orca terminal input

say_en.text: Hand this task off to another agent
say_en.note: Hands off the current Orca session
